install_output_empty: Palije vyakufumapo pa nyengo iyi. Mizere ya terminal kufuma ku chida cha kuŵika yizamuwoneka pano.
linux_setup_title: Linux Kuŵala & SP Kuŵala Chida Kukhazikiska
linux_setup_welcome: Kuŵika Chida cha SP Flash cha Linux
linux_setup_welcome_desc: Kukopera na kuŵika injini yakuwala mwaluŵiro mwakuti muwezgerepo na kusintha player yinu kwambura kusuzgika.
linux_card_engine_desc: Chida cha MediaTek chakuwala chomene na laibulale ya pa charu chose chapasi.
linux_card_usb_desc: Kupereka chizomerezgo cha pa kompyuta kuti muyowoye na woseŵera mu nthowa ya Bootloader.
system_checker_title: SP Flash Chida Nthowa Yakuwonera na Kupima
system_checker_desc: Kukhozgera kwakukwana kwa madalaivala, ma module gha kernel, vizomerezgo, na malaibulale gha nyengo yakuchitira vinthu kuti ŵawoneseske kuti ŵakuŵala mwakugomezgeka.
settings_checker_desc_installer: Kunozga kompyuta yinu kuti yikolerane na player yinu kuti yiŵe na mapulogiramu ghasono.
settings_checker_desc_advanced: Kuwona umo Linux yikuŵikika pa SP Flash Tool, mwaŵi wa USB, vizomerezgo vya serial, na vigaŵa vinyake vya dongosolo.
settings_checker_desc_friendly: Kunozga kompyuta yinu kuti yikolerane na player yinu na kuŵikamo mapulogiramu ghasono mwakugomezgeka.
settings_checker_desc: Kunozga kompyuta yinu kuti yikolerane na player yinu na kuŵikamo mapulogiramu ghasono mwakugomezgeka.
linux_prep_ready_friendly: Kompyuta yinu njakunozgeka kulumikizgika ku player yinu.
linux_prep_ready: Kunozga, Chida cha SP Flash chikunozgeka.
linux_prep_blocked: Kompyuta iyi yingagwiliskira ntchito yayi chida cha SP Flash.
linux_prep_fix_body: Password yinu yikukhumbikwa kamoza kuti muŵike kompyuta iyi kuti yiŵe yakuwala: malango gha USB gha vipangizo vya MediaTek na kufika pa doko la serial.
linux_prep_fix_body_wizard: Kuti muŵike kompyuta iyi kuti yiŵe ya SP Flash Tool, pasiwedi yinu yizamukhumbikwa mu chigaŵa chakulondezgapo kuti muŵike malango gha USB na kusazgako akaunti yinu ku magulu ghakukhumbikwa gha ŵakugwiliskira ntchito serial. Usange mwakana, pulogiramu iyi yizamujara.
linux_prep_fixed: Kufika kwazomerezgeka, Chida cha SP Flash chanozgeka.
linux_prep_reboot_body: Kuŵika vinthu kwamara ndipo akaunti yinu yasazgikika ku magulu gha awo ŵakugwiliskira ntchito SP Flash Tool. Chonde yambaniso kompyuta yinu kuti vizomerezgo viphya vimbe kugwira ntchito, ndipo julaniso pulogiramu iyi. Dofyani pa chimanyikwiro kuti mujale pulogiramu iyi sono.
linux_prep_reboot_done_btn: Mwachita, Jalani pulogiramu kuti muyambiskeso kompyuta
settings_driver_desc: Pambere mundaseŵezeske pulogiramu iyi kakwamba, mukwenera kuŵika dalaivala wa MediaTek USB, ndipo pamanyuma muyambiskeso kompyuta yinu.
home_desc: Penjani firmware pa Intaneti panji sankhani phukusi la ku malo ghinu, ndipo muŵike pa chipangizo chinu.
sel_source_desc: Dawunilodirani firmware pa intaneti, panji kwizani na phukusi la charu chinu.
settings_advanced_desc: Kulongora nthowa yakuŵikiramo, umo mungaŵikiramo na kusefa vyakufumiska.
settings_track_multiple_toggle: Remind me about multiple releases on a single model
settings_track_multiple_desc: Keeps a record of every release installed on the same model. With more than one on record the app cannot tell your players apart, so an install asks which software is running and whether to keep your settings and media. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
settings_track_multiple_warn_body: With more than one release tracked for a model, every install for that model asks which software is on the player and whether to keep your settings and media, because the app cannot tell one player from another. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
settings_guided_install_desc: App iyi yikukhala namwe para mwazima, kulumikizga, na kuŵika.
settings_terminal_install: Kuŵika kufuma pa windo la terminal
settings_sp_gui_install: Ikani mu SP Flash Chida GUI
settings_sp_gui_desc: Kujara Updater CE na kujura SP Flash Tool GUI na fayilo yakusankhika ya firmware yakuthandazgika na vithuzithuzi vyakugaŵira ivyo vyaŵikika pakwamba.
settings_terminal_desc: Kuseŵezeska mapulogalamu ghinu mu Terminal kuti muwone uthenga waukadaulo pa umo vinthu vikwendela.
settings_terminal_desc_windows: Kuseŵezeska mapulogalamu ghinu mu Command Prompt kuti muwone uthenga waukadaulo pa umo vinthu vikwendera.
settings_sp_auth_desc: Mwakusankha. Vinthu vinyake vya MediaTek vikukana kuwala mpaka apo SP Flash Tool yipelekeke fayilo yakukhozgera (.auth); ŵikanipo vyanu pano usange chipangizo chikukhumba chimoza.
terminal_install_no_scatter: Palije fayilo yakuthandazgika iyo yikasangika mu phukusi ili, ntheura palije dango la console ilo likapangika.
terminal_install_no_tool: Palije SP Flash Tool kuzenga panji malo ghakunjilirapo gha MTKClient agho ghalipo pa nthowa iyi.
terminal_install_failed: Tingajula yayi windo la terminal. Lamulo la kuŵika likalembeka ku {path}.
status_terminal_install: Kuŵika lamulo lakujulika mu windo lanu la terminal ({path}).
terminal_install_prompt_body:
{terminal_name} sono yizamujulika kuthamanga {method}.

• Usange yindazime kale, zimani magesi pa {device} yinu.
• Usange yalumikizgika ku USB, dankha yiwuskapo.
{hint}
• Lumikizani chipangizo chinu na kompyuta yinu para windo la {terminal_name} lajulika.

Dofyani OK kuti muyambiske na kufumamo mu Updater CE.
terminal_hint_innioasis: • Ulongozgi: Usange chipangizo chikulumikizgika yayi, mukwenera kudina batani la reset ilo lili mu pinhole na paperclip apo mukulumikizga khebo ya USB.
terminal_hint_generic: • Ulongozgi: Ŵikani chipangizo chinu mu firmware download mode (vikupambana na model: e.g., fumiskani batire na kuyisunga kuwaro na khebo ya USB iyo yalumikizgika, panji zimani magesi na batire, panji gwirani Volume Down/Up apo mukulumikizga USB).
sp_gui_install_prompt_title: Ikani kwizira mu SP Flash Chida GUI
sp_gui_install_prompt_body:
SP Flash Tool GUI sono yizamujulika na pulogiramu yinu yakuŵikika pakwamba.

• Mu SP Flash Tool, sankhani "Kukopera" kufuma mu bokosi lakudontha.
• Dofyani batani lakuti "Dawunilodirani".
• Woneseskani kuti {device} yinu yazima na kuleka kulumikizgika.
{hint}
• Lumikizani khebo ya USB pa kompyuta yinu para mwadina pa Download.

Dofyani OK kuti muyambiske Chida cha SP Flash na kufumamo mu Updater CE.
settings_install_themes_desc: Para vyazomerezgeka, mitu ya Rockbox yikusamuskika ku Y1 para yaŵikika makora Rockbox.
themes_placement_failed_note: Tikatondeka kuŵika themes pack pa player yinu. Mungayezgaso kufuma pa vyakuŵikapo.
settings_rockbox_desc: Kugwiriskira ncito para mukupenja mapulogiramu ghakufuma mu mapulogiramu.
settings_original_pre307_warn_body:
Mapulogalamu ghakwamba ghakale kuluska 3.0.7 ghakukolerana yayi na mayuniti gha Y1 agho ghakuguliskika na Innioasis OS 3.0.7. Kuŵala kwakuzenga kwakale pa mayuniti agha kuzamuŵatondeska kuti ŵaleke kuyamba mpaka apo mtundu uphya uŵikikengeso.

Kasi mukusimikizga kuti mukukhumba kulongora mapulogiramu ghakwambilira ghakale kuluska 3.0.7?
settings_filter_nightly: Longorani vyakufumiskika vya Dev wa usiku
settings_240p_tip: Kuwoneska kuzenga awo zip ya ROM ni 240p yakupambanapambana (rom ... _240p.zip). 240p kuzenga kukukolerana yayi na mayuniti gha Y1 pa Innioasis OS pasi pa 3.0.7, ntheura Longorani Rockbox Yakale Yakuzenga yikuzomerezgeka nayo.
settings_old_rockbox_warn_body:
Kufumiskika kwa Rockbox-Y1 pambere 0.5 yindafike kukukolerana yayi na mayuniti gha Y1 agho ghakuguliskika pamanyuma pa Malichi 2026 na Innioasis OS 3.0.7 iyo yikaŵikika pakwamba.

Kuŵala kwakuzenga kwakale pa vipangizo ivi kuzamutondeska kuyamba.

Kasi mukusimikizga kuti mukukhumba kulongora vithuzithuzi vyakale vya Rockbox?
sel_back_to_online: ← Kuwelera ku Mapulogalamu gha pa Intaneti
sel_prompt_need_firmware: Chonde sankhani .zip, .rar archive, panji fayilo yakuthandazgika (*kuthandazgika*.txt) mukati mwa chikwatu cha pulogiramu kuti muŵike pulogiramu iyo mwasankha pa {target} yinu.
sel_offline: Vinthu ivyo vikulembeka pa Intaneti vikusangika yayi sono. Gwiliskirani nchito fayilo ya mu cigaŵa cinu, panji wonani umo mukukolerana.
rockbox_themes_notice_body: Rockbox on Y1 no longer supports iPod classic (240p) themes from Rockbox.org. You'll have to use 360p Rockbox themes made for Y1. Click next to continue.
sel_multiple_scatters_error: Mapaketi ghanandi gha firmware panji mafayilo ghakuthandazgika ghakasangika mu chikwatu ichi. Chonde sankhani foda panji archive iyo yili na firmware yimoza pera pa nyengo yimoza.
sel_multiple_scatters_release_error: Kufumiskika uku kuli na mafayilo ghakuthandazgika ghakujumpha limoza, ntheura Updater wangamanya yayi kuti woseŵera winu wakukhumba wuli. Munthu uyo ​​wakapanga {software} wangakhumbikwira kusintha ivyo wakufumiska pa firmware kuti waŵe na fayilo yimoza pera yakuthandazgika.
sp_search_restart: Palije chipangizo pa nyengo iyi, kupenjaso (yezgani {count}). Sungani magesi ya player na kuyilumikiza para mwaphalirika.
sp_auth_missing_file: Fayilo yakukhozgera yikusangika yayi ({path}); kuwala kwambura iyo.
sp_config_missing_platform: Fayilo ya scatter yikupharazga yayi pulatifomu yake, ntheura kukhazikika kwa console kwa fayilo yakukhozgera kukatondeka kuzengeka; kuwala kwambura iyo.
sp_config_missing_storage: Fayilo yakuthandazgika yikupharazga yayi mtundu wa kusungirako (EMMC / NAND / UFS), ntheura kukhazikika kwa console kwa fayilo yakukhozgera kukatondeka kuzengeka; kuwala kwambura iyo.
sp_config_no_auth_file: Palije fayilo yakukhozgera iyo yikapelekeka; kuwala kwambura yumoza.
sp_config_write_failed: Tingalemba yayi fayilo yakusintha kwa console; kuwala kwambura fayilo yakukhozgera.
settings_notifications_desc: Longorani vimanyisko vya dongosolo vya chimanyisko na mitundu ya kusintha pasi apa. Off wakusunga vyose mukati mwa pulogiramu.
settings_add_device_type_hint: Mtundu ndi woseŵera wa hardware kusintha. Ŵaseŵera ŵa mtundu umoza ŵangazengeka mu kusintha kwakujumpha kamoza — mwachiyelezgero Mtundu A na Mtundu B — ndipo mapulogalamu ghakupangika kwa yumoza wa iwo. Wonani chidindo icho chili kuseri kwa woseŵera; usange likuyowoya yayi zina la mtundu, musiyeni chisankho chakwamba.
settings_add_device_no_versions: Palije mitundu iyo yilipo ya pulogiramu iyi sonosono apa.
settings_notifications_unavailable: Vimanyikwiro vya dongosolo vikusangika yayi pa kompyuta iyi.
settings_run_in_background_group: Kuthamanga mu background kuti muwone vimanyikwiro
settings_run_in_background_desc_menu_bar: Sungani pulogiramu iyi mu menyu para windo lajara, mwakuti muŵe na vimanyikwiro vya kusintha kwa pulogiramu na firmware ya player. Off: kujala windo kukuleka pulogiramu.
settings_run_in_background_desc_system_t: Sungani pulogiramu iyi mu thireyi ya dongosolo para windo lajara, mwakuti muŵe ŵakupokera vimanyikwiro vya kusintha kwa pulogiramu na firmware ya player. Off: kujala windo kukuleka pulogiramu.
settings_offline_mode_desc: Bisani katalogu ya ŵanthu ŵa pa intaneti na kuŵika mapulogiramu kufuma mu mafayilo gha mu chigaŵa chinu pera.
sel_themepack_prompt_body: Mwaŵala 360p Rockbox kuzenga. Kasi mungatemwa kuŵika 360p Theme Pack pa chipangizo ichi sono?
sel_themepack_guidance_title: Lumikizani Player mu USB Kusungirako Mode
sel_themepack_guidance_body:
Chonde fumyanipo USB, ŵikani magesi na kuŵika mu Rockbox kamoza (ntheura yikuyambiska chikwatu chake cha mukati cha .rockbox), ndipo fumyanipo USB na kusankha 'USB Storage Mode'.

Para mwalumikizgika, dofyani pa Continue kuti musankhe chikwatu chilichose pa player yinu.
sel_themepack_select_folder: Sankhani chikwatu chilichose pa malo ghakusungirako maseŵero ghinu
sel_themepack_success: Rockbox Theme Pack yaŵikika makora pa chipangizo chinu!
sel_dialog_filter: Mafayilo gha Firmware (*.zip *.rar *kuthandazgika*.txt *.txt);;Malo ghakusungirako (*.zip *.rar);;Mafayilo ghakuthandazgika (*kuthandazgika*.txt *.txt);;Mafayilo ghose (*.*)
sel_only_local: Sankhani phukusi la .zip panji .rar la firmware, panji chikwatu / scatter .txt fayilo, kuti muŵikepo kwambura intaneti, palije intaneti yakukhumbikwa. Kugwira ntchito na Innioasis yiliyose na Timmkoo woseŵera wakupulika.
sel_only_local_generic: Sankhani phukusi la firmware la m’dera (.zip, .rar) panji chikwatu icho chili na fayilo yakuthandazgika kuti muŵikepo kwambura intaneti, yikugwira ntchito na vipangizo vya MediaTek vyakumanyikwa.
sel_offline_install: Ŵikani pulogiramu yakukhora kufuma ku fayilo ya .zip panji .rar pa chipangizo chilichose cha Innioasis panji Timmkoo.
sel_offline_install_generic: Ŵikani pulogiramu ya kompyuta kufuma ku .zip / .rar archive panji chikwatu cha pulogiramu ya kompyuta pa vipangizo vya MediaTek vyakumanyikwa.
sel_update_available: Pali update ya {software} iyo yikusangika pa {model} yinu.
conn_offline: Muli kuwaro kwa intaneti. Kuŵika kufuma ku malo ghakusungirako mapulogiramu gha mu chikaya kukusangika yayi.
conn_archive_unavailable: Catalog ya firmware yingafika yayi kwa nyengo yichoko waka. Mungaŵikaso kufuma ku archive panji mafayilo gha mu chigaŵa chinu.
single_instance_body: Kopi yinyake njakujulika, panji yichali kugwira ntchito kumanyuma. Makope ghaŵiri ghangapikisana kuti ghaŵe na USB ya player, ntheura iyi yizamuyamba yayi.
single_instance_focus_failed: Kopi iyo yikaŵa kuti yikuchimbira yikazgora yayi pempho lakuti yilongore windo lake. Lingaŵa lakutangwanika panji lakupendera. Kukakamiza kuyileka kuzamutimbanizga chilichose icho yikuŵika.
single_instance_force_failed: Kopi iyo yikaŵa kuti yikuchitika yikatondeka kumara. Lekani mwekha, ndipo yambaniso updater.
single_instance_busy_body: Kopi yakuchitika yikuŵika mapulogalamu panji kuyowoya na woseŵera, ntheura kuyimalizga sono kungatimbanizga nthena. Kuyambiska uku kuzamujara; gwiriskani ntchito windo ilo lilipo panji chithuzithuzi chake cha menyu para kuŵika kwamara.
notices_how_community: Mo vimanyikwiro vya mu chikaya vikugwilira ntchito
notices_summary_body: Julani Notices mu pulogiramu kuti muŵazge.
toast_battery_charged: Pambere mundaseŵezeske ivi pa player yinu, charger batire kwa ora limoza .
toast_battery_charged_device: Pambere mundaseŵezeske ivi pa chipangizo chinu, chajani batire kwa ora limoza .
toast_background_notifications_menu_bar: Lekani vimanyikwiro vyakumanyuma kuti mupokelere vyakusintha na kupeleka vimanyikwiro nangauli Updater yajalika ku menyu bar.
toast_background_notifications_system_tr: Lekani vimanyikwiro vyakumanyuma kuti mupokelere vinthu viphya na kupereka vimanyisko nangauli Updater yajalika pa thireyi ya dongosolo.
translate_unavailable_notice_body: Mauteŵeti ghakung'anamura pa intaneti sonosono apa ghakusangika yayi panji ghali pa nyengo yakuzizima. Manotisi ghakwamba ghakufumiskika ghazamulongosoreka m’malo mwake.
translate_unavailable_hint: Kumasulira kukusangika yayi kwa nyengo yichoko waka. Wonani intaneti yinu panji yezganiso pamanyuma.
update_store_available_fmt: {new} yikusangika mu sitoro ya Microsoft (muli na {current}).
sel_notes_hint: Sankhani ivyo vyafumiskika kuti muwone ivyo vyasintha
flash_wait_desc: Zimani chipangizo choyamba. Usange yalumikizgika kweni yikuwoneka yayi, yezgani kuŵika khebo panji doko linyake la USB.
dialog_pre_install_header: Chonde wonani kuti {model} yinu yazima ndipo yalumikizgika yayi na USB .
dialog_pre_install_innioasis_tip:
• Zimani magesi ghose pa chipangizo chinu pambere mundambe.
• Usange chipangizo chazizima panji chikuzgora yayi, gwiriskani ntchito pini panji paperclip mu mbuna ya reset kuti mukakamizge magesi kuti yizime mu nthowa yakukopera.
• Sungani khebo ya USB kuti yileke kulumikizgika pa nyengo yasono.
• Dofyani pa Continue, ndipo pamanyuma mulumikizge chipangizo chinu kwizira pa USB para mwaphalirika.
dialog_pre_install_generic_tip:
• Zimani nkhongono zose pa chipangizo chinu cha MediaTek.
• Sungani khebo ya USB kuti yileke kulumikizgika pa nyengo yasono.
• Kuyana na mtundu, yezgani kulumikizga na panji kwambura batire (panji kukhozga Volume Down / Up apo mukulumikizga).
• Dofyani pa Continue, ndipo pamanyuma mulumikizge khebo ya USB para mwaphalirika.
sel_keep_data_incompatible: Tingasunga yayi data yinu pa install iyi chifukwa firmware iyo muli nayo sono yikukolerana yayi na Keep Data.
flash_paperclip_explanation: Lekani nthambo ya USB na kugwiliskira nchito paperclip panji pini kuti mudinizge batani la reset, ndipo pamanyuma yezgani kulumikizgaso.
flash_hint_wall_charger: • Ntchiwemi kuti munthu walumikizge player ku chaja ya pa mtenje kwa maminiti 30 m’paka ora limoza pambere wandayezge kulumikizga.
flash_hint_install_drivers: • Usange muli pa Windows, wonani kuti muli na <a href='https.
flash_hint_windows_reboot_driver: • Ma PC gha Windows ghakwenera kuyambaso para ghaŵika dalaivala pambere ghandaseŵezeskeke kakwamba.
keep_data_running_fmt_no_name: Kasi pulogiramu iyi yaŵikika kale pa {model} yinu?
install_first_which_firmware: Kasi ni pulogiramu wuli iyo yikugwira ntchito pa {model} yinu sono?
install_first_which_firmware_hint: Usange mukukayika, sankhani ‘Vinyake’ panji pulogiramu iyo mukughanaghana kuti yili kuŵikika.
install_first_prerequisite_hint: Kuti mulutilire na kuŵika uku, chonde manya usange {model} yinu yikugwiliskira kale ntchito pulogiramu yakukhumbikwa ({software}).
keep_data_only_compatible_hint: Tingasunga waka vinthu ivyo mwaŵika na vyakusanguluska para player yili kale na pulogiramu iyi panji mtundu wakukolerana.
keep_data_only_compatible_hint_y1: Tingasunga waka ivyo mwaŵika para player yili kale na pulogiramu iyi panji mtundu wakukolerana.
keep_data_only_compatible_hint_other: Tingasunga waka vinthu ivyo mwaŵika na vyakusanguluska para player yili kale na pulogiramu iyi panji mtundu wakukolerana.
settings_allow_keep_data_any: Zomerezgani kusunga vyakuŵikapo na vyakusanguluska pa firmware yiliyose iyo mwaŵika
settings_allow_keep_data_any_desc: Kujumphizga fumbo la kukolerana. Gwiliskiranipo waka ivi para mukusimikizga kuti seŵero lilutilirenge kugwira ntchito na ivyo vikuŵikika sonosono apa na vyakusanguluska.
err_keep_data_failed: Tingasunga yayi vyakuŵikapo na vyakusanguluska: chikwatu cha firmware chikulembeka yayi. Palije ico cikaŵikika.
flash_keep_data_tooltip: Kusunga ma settings ghinu na media pa player. Mapulogalamu ghanyake ghose ghakuŵikika nga umo vikuŵira nyengo zose.
flash_keep_data_warning: Usange mukulutilira kwambura ivi, ivyo mwaŵika na vyakusanguluska vizamuŵikikaso pa malo ghakusungirako vinthu gha mukati gha player.
flash_keep_data_warning_rockbox_y1: Usange mukulutilira kwambura ivi, mitu yinu ya Rockbox, mafonti na vyakuŵikapo vizamufumiskikapo. Nyimbo zinu na vinthu vinyake vizamukhala pa player.
flash_keep_data_warning_rockbox: Usange mukulutilira kwambura ivi, mitu yinu ya Rockbox, mafonti na vyakuŵikapo vizamufumiskikapo, ndipo malo ghakusungirako vinthu gha mukati gha player ghazamuŵikikaso.
flash_keep_data_warning_y1: Usange mulutilirenge kwambura ivi, ivyo mwaŵika vizamuŵikikaso. Nyimbo zinu na vinthu vinyake vizamukhala pa player.
format_all_data_warning_y1: Firmware iyi yikwenera kusintha malo ghakusungirako vinthu mukati mwa player. Vinthu ivyo vyasungika vizamufumiskikapo; sumu zinu na vinyake vyakupharazgira vizamukhala pa malo ghake.
format_all_data_warning_other: Firmware iyi yikwenera kusintha malo ghakusungirako vinthu mukati mwa player. Vinthu ivyo vyasungika na vyakusanguluska ivyo vyasungika pa malo ghakusungirako vinthu vizamufumiskikapo. Media pa microSD yinu yikukhala mu malo ghake.
format_all_confirm_question: Kupangaso malo ghakusungirako vinthu vya mukati pa {model} yinu?
format_all_confirm_body:
Pa {software} tikwenera kupangaso {model} yinu ya mukati pambere tindalutilire. Pamanyuma pake, SP Flash Tool yinyake yizamuyezgeka, kweni mu nthowa ya Fomati Yose + Kukopera kwizira mu XML console-mode run.

{data_effect}
format_all_recovery: Lekani USB, ndipo pamanyuma muŵikepo chingwe cha pepala panji pini mu chibowo cha pinhole cha reset pa {model} yinu. Dofyani pa Next kuti muyezgeso mu Fomati Vyose + Dawunilodi.
err_pmt_format_required_desc: SP Flash Tool yikati tebulo la kugaŵira la woseŵera likasintha (8502). Firmware iyi yikwenera kuŵikika mu nthowa ya Format All + Download, iyo yikunozgaso malo ghakusungirako vinthu mukati.

support_story_1_headline: Para ŵakupanga vinthu ŵakuluta panthazi, ŵanthu ŵakukwera.
support_story_1_lead: Kuvikilira chipangizo chinu ku misampha ya hardware yambura kuyowoya na kusintha kwakuphwanyika.
support_story_1_body: Innioasis nyengo zose wakufumiska ma firmware ghaphya gha ŵakuseŵera nga ni Y1 (kukhumba kusintha kwakubisika kwa bolodi nga ni 6.0, 7.0, na 8.0) ivyo vikuswa vipangizo vyakale mwakufwasa. Kuŵinya chomene ntchakuti webusayiti yawo yikupereka chenjezgo la zero ndiposo zero kufika ku ma firmware ghakale ghakugwira ntchito kuti ŵachire kufuma ku mtundu wa njerwa. Updater CE na Community Firmware project ŵakutora vigaŵa: tikusunga ROM yiliyose yakale, kukhozgera mwaŵene kusintha kwa hardware yinu, na kusunga woseŵera winu kuti waŵe wakuvikilirika.

support_story_1_item_2: Ma ROM ghakusungika: Kuwunganya kwakukwana kwa ma firmware ghakwambilira gha ku fakitare Innioasis wakufumiskikapo.
support_story_1_item_3: Pulatifomu ya Mtanda: Vipangizo vyakuwonekera vya macOS, Linux, na Windows mwakuyana waka.
support_story_1_item_4: Hardware Intelligence: Kuziŵa kwakujiyimira paŵekha kwa bolodi mwakuti nyengo zose mupokere phukusi lakukwana.
support_story_2_headline: Palije ma Google Drive ghakuphwanyika. Palije ntchito yakughanaghana. Firmware yakugwira ntchito waka.
support_story_2_lead: Liwiro likuru, vyakukhozgeka vyakupangika vya mu chikaya ivyo mungathemba nadi.
support_story_2_body: Kulondezga mapulogalamu gha Innioasis ghakuzomerezgeka kanandi kukung’anamura kufufuza maforamu gha Google Drive agho ghamara nyengo yake, kugaŵana kwa mtambo wa Baidu wakufwa, na mafayilo gha zip ghakuziziswa kwambura vipangizo vyakuwala. Tikapanga netiweki yakugomezgeka, yakujiyimira payokha yakuchitira dawunilodi na kugomezgeka kwa SHA-256, vimanyikwiro vyakusintha, na kuŵika vinthu mwakulongozgeka pa sitepe na sitepe. Vinthu ivyo mukupeleka vikusunga mwaluŵiro ivyo mwakopera na kuvipokelera ivyo vikupangiska kuti ivi vichitike maora 24 pa zuŵa, mazuŵa 365 pa chaka.
support_story_2_item_1: Direct High-Speed ​​CDN: Kukopera mwaluŵiro, mwaluŵiro kwambura mphaka ya kukoka panji malinki ghakufwa.
support_story_2_item_2: Update Notifications: Chenjezgekani nyengo iyo ŵanthu ŵaphya ŵakufumiska panji ŵakunozga vinthu.
support_story_2_item_3: Kuŵika Kulongozgeka pa Sitepe na Sitepe: Vinthu vyakuwoneka makora vikumulongozgani pa nyengo yiliyose iyo mukukanizga batani.
support_story_2_item_4: Ŵanthu Ŵakuyowoya Viyowoyero Vinandi: Ŵakuyowoya Chingelezi, Chitchaina, Chijeremani, Chisipanishi, Chifurenchi na Chijapanizi.
support_story_3_headline: Kujula nkhongono zose za woseŵera winu wa Innioasis.
support_story_3_lead: Kubwera na Rockbox, ndondomeko zakugwiliskira ntchito zambura kulemera chomene, na wanangwa wa audiophile.
support_story_3_body: Mapulogalamu gha ku fakitare ya Stock ghakukhwaska waka ivyo hardware yinu ya Y1 panji Y2 yingachita. Ŵanthu ŵa mu chigaŵa chithu ŵakapangiska kuti Rockbox, mapulogiramu ghambura kulemera chomene, kuseŵera kwa codec ya audiophile, na nkhani zakupangika na ŵanthu ziŵe zamoyo. Tikugura vinthu vyakupambanapambana vyakuwoneka kufuma mu thumba kuti tiyezge, kusintha injiniya, na kukhozgera kuŵika kulikose. Kukhozgera Updater CE mwachindunji kukupeleka ndalama ku mayuniti agha ghakuyezga na kuchimbizga luŵiro kupanga mapulogiramu ghakupangika na ŵanthu.
support_story_3_item_1: Rockbox ya Kudinizga Kamoza: Kuseŵera kwa Audiophile na mitu yakuzomerezgeka yikuŵikika mu masekondi.
support_story_3_item_2: Firmware ya mu chikaya: Kunozga batire, UI yakutowa, na wovwiri wa codec ya mazuŵa ghano.
support_story_3_item_3: Active Hardware Lab: Tikuyezga pa vipangizo vyeneko vyakuwoneka pambere tindafumyepo kuzenga kulikose.
support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% yaulere, mapulogalamu ghakwamba ghakubisika kwambura malonda panji kulondezga.
support_story_4_headline: Tiwovwirani kuchita ivyo Innioasis wakuchita yayi.
support_story_4_lead: Kusungika kwa firmware yakupangika na ŵanthu kuti vipangizo vinu vileke kuŵa pa malo ghakuponyamo viswaswa.
support_story_4_body: Para kampani ya hardware yikuluta ku chipangizo chawo chinyake, mitundu yakale yikulekeka. Innioasis wakupereka wovwiri wa Linux yayi, palije kusintha kwakuwonekera, ndipo palije nthowa yipusu yakuchizgira para kuŵika kwatondeka. Updater CE ilipo chifukwa awo ŵakuseŵezeska mwachitemwa ŵakwenera yayi kutaya seŵero la sumu liwemi chomene. 100% ya vyakupeleka vya ŵanthu vikuluta ku kusunga chida ichi kuti chiŵe chakujulika kwa waliyose.
support_story_4_item_1: Rescue & Unbrick: Kuwombora kuchira kukuyenda nanga ni para vipangizo vikukana kuyamba.
support_story_4_item_2: Wovwiri wa Linux Wakwamba: Wovwira mwakukwana MediaTek wakuwala pa Linux distros.
support_story_4_item_3: Transparent Changelogs: Mazgu ghakufumiskika mwakudumura mwakuti mumanye makora ivyo vikusintha.
support_story_4_item_4: 100% Community Funded: Khofi waliyose wakusunga malo ghakusungiramo vinthu vyakale ghakujulika ndiposo ghambura kulipiliska kwa wose.
support_methods_subtitle: Sankhani nthowa iyo mukukhumba kupelekera vyawanangwa. Chawanangwa chilichose chikupeleka ndalama zakukopera, kuseŵezeska, na kuyezga hardware.

linux_usb_grant_desc: Mupeleke vizomerezgo kamoza kuti pulogiramu iyi yiyowoye na chipangizo chinu.
linux_perms_ok_msg: Vizomerezgo vya USB & malango gha udev ghaŵikika makora. Mauteŵeti ghakonkheka.
donate_rely_on_you: Tiwovwirani na ndalama zakuchitira vinthu, perekani vyawanangwa lero.

status_app_reset_defaults: Pulogalamu iyi yaŵikikaso pa malo ghake, cache yakukopera yafumiskikapo, ndipo vikumbusko vya batire vyawezgekerapo.
log_app_reset_defaults: Kunozga kwa mapulogalamu ghakuŵikikaso pakwamba, cache yakukopera yafumiskikapo, ndipo kukumbuska kwa batire kwawezgekerapo (R).
flash_watch_waiting_hint: Lutilirani kuŵikamo, Rockbox yikwamba ndipo mitu yake yizamusazgikirapo yekha.
flash_watch_found: Woseŵera wasangika, kusazgako mitu ya Rockbox...
flash_watch_timeout_hint: Wonani kuti yaŵikika mu magesi na kuzgoka. Usange mdima ukukhala, dinani pini mu mbuna ya reset na kukora batani la pakati (Y1) panji batani la magesi (ŵaseŵera ŵanyake) kuti muyambiskeso. Usange nchakuti chizamuyamba yayi, firmware yikatora yayi, ŵikanipo yinyake.
action_flash_complete: Flash yamara! Lekani USB na kuyambiskaso.
action_recover_powercycle: Nkhongono-kuzungulira woseŵera (gwirani nkhongono ~ 10s), ndipo muyilumikizgeso - kuyezgaso...
action_wait_mtk: Kulindilira chipangizo cha MTK... Zimani chipangizo na kulumikizga USB.
action_da_stall: Chipangizo chikaleka kuzgora apo ŵakanozga wovwiri wa dawunilodi. Zimani magesi ghose, lumikizaniso, na kuyezgaso.
action_detected_brom: Chipangizo chasangika (BROM mode) - kunozga wovwiri wakukopera...
action_detected_preloader: Chipangizo chasangika (mode ya preloader) - kunozga wovwiri wakukopera...
action_da_wait_back: Munthu uyo ​​wakaseŵeranga wakaleka kuzgora apo wakambiska wovwiri wakukopera. Kulindilira kuti yiwelere...
action_formatting: Kupanga mafomati gha data na cache...
log_install_writing: Kuŵika mu Progress - kulemba vithuzithuzi vya firmware...
log_sparse_fmt: Chithunzithunzi cha Android chasangika cha {part}, kusintha mu ndondomeko...
err_code_sp_not_found: Chida cha SP Flash chikusangika yayi
err_code_missing_images: Vithuzithuzi vya firmware vikusoŵa mu phukusi
err_code_partition_table_invalid: Kukhozgera kwa thebulu lakugaŵira kwatondeka pamanyuma pa kulemba
err_sp_wrong_model: Mwalumikizga chiyelezgero cha woseŵera wakubudika. Dofyani batani la × kuti mulekeske kuŵika uku, ndipo sankhani pulogiramu ya player iyo mwaŵika.
err_sp_timeout: Chida chikawonapo yayi woseŵera. Muŵe ŵakuzima na kuwuskapo magesi, ndipo pamanyuma mulumikizge khebo ya USB para mwaphalirika.
err_sp_brom_startcmd: Woseŵera wakapokera nkhongono mwaluŵiro chomene. Zimani magesi ghose, ndipo pamanyuma muyilumikizgeso.
err_sp_download_fail: Kulemba kukatimbanizgika. Wonani khebo ya USB na doko ndiposo charge ya batire, ndipo yezganiso.
err_sp_da_init_sync: Wovwiri wa dawunilodi wakatondeka kwamba. Yezga nthowa yinyake ya flash.
err_sp_brom_da_fail: Wovwiri wakukopera wakatondeka kutumizgika ku player. Zimani magesi na kulumikizgaso.
err_sp_da_invalid_type: Munthu uyo ​​wakaseŵeranga wakakana wovwiri wakukopera (kubudika 6104). Gwiliskirani nchito Download Agent iyo yili pamoza na SP Flash Tool, ndipo wonani usange pulogiramu iyi yikuyana na woseŵera uyu.
err_sp_com_port: Chida ichi chikatondeka kujura doko lake la serial. Jalani vipangizo vinyake vyakuwala na kulumikizgaso.
err_com_port_reboot_suggestion: Doko la USB COM likatondeka kujulika (kubudika 1013). Kuyambiskaso kompyuta yinu kuzamufumiska doko ilo lajara. Chonde yambaniso kompyuta yinu na kuyezgaso.
err_sp_enable_dram: Chida ichi chikatondeka kwamba kukumbukira kwa woseŵera. Gwiliskirani nchito phukusi ilo likapangika kuti liŵe la chiyelezgero ichi.
err_sp_storage_read: Chida ichi chikaŵa kuti chingaŵazga yayi ivyo woseŵera wakasunga. Wonani umo vikukolerana; chipangizo chingaŵa na suzgo la hardware.
err_attempt_timeout: Chida chakuwala chikalongora kuti palije kuluta panthazi mu masekondi {seconds}, ntheura kuyezgayezga uku kukalekeka.
err_connection_failed_desc: Tingakwaniska yayi kukhazikiska mgwirizano wakukhora na woseŵera. Woneseskani kuti chipangizo chazima (gwiriskani ntchito pini kuti mudinizge batani la reset usange mukukhumbikwira), fumiskani USB, na kulumikizgaso para mwaphalirika.
err_flash_write_failed_desc: Kuŵala kwatimbanizgika panji ntchito ya kulemba yikatondeka. Wonani usange khebo ya USB yaŵikika makora ndiposo kuti batire lili na magesi ghakukwana, ndipo yezganiso.
err_mtk_output_stall_desc: Chida chakuwala chalongora mzere umoza kwa masekondi {seconds} ghakumasinda ndipo chikuwoneka kuti chikulutilira yayi kulemba firmware. Flash yingaŵa kuti yatondeka. Usange ichi chikaŵa chakumaliya pa kuyezgayezga kuŵiri na nthowa yiliyose pa ndondomeko iyo yingaweleraso pakati pawo, panji usange MTKClient pera ndiyo yilipo pa makina agha, yambaniso kompyuta na kuyezgaso.
err_only_mtkclient_desc: MTKClient pera ndiyo yikusangika pakuŵika ivi. Flash yingaŵa kuti yatondeka. Chonde yambaniso kompyuta na kuyezgaso.
err_mtk_output_stall_fallback_available: Kompyuta iyi yingaŵikikaso mwakugwiliskira ntchito SP Flash Tool. Usange mungakwaniska, sinthani ku SP Flash Tool na kuyezgaso.
prompt_restart_and_quit_desc: Flash yingaŵa kuti yatondeka. Chonde ŵerengani uthenga uwo uli pachanya na kuyambiskaso kompyuta pambere mundayezgeso. Usange mwakhwaska OK, pulogiramu iyi yizamuleka kuti muyambiskeso.
err_missing_package_files_title: Package ya Firmware yambura kugwira ntchito
err_missing_package_files_desc: Phukusi la firmware likusoŵa fayilo yakuthandazgika panji mafayilo ghakukhumbikwa gha vithuzithuzi. Chonde dawunilodiniso phukusi panji sankhani fayilo yose ya firmware.
err_auth_file_unusable_desc: Fayilo yakukhozgera iyo mwasankha yikusoŵa, yilije kanthu panji yingalembeka yayi. Sankhani fayilo yakuzomerezgeka, panji muwuskemo mu Settings, ndipo pamanyuma muwoneso.
err_tool_unavailable_desc: Chida chakuwala panji madalaivala ghakukhumbikwa gha dongosolo ghakatondeka kuyambiska. Chonde wonani vizomerezgo vya dongosolo, ndondomeko ya dalayivara, panji ŵikaniso pulogiramu.
err_driver_missing_title: Dalaivala wa USB wa MediaTek wakukhumbikwa
err_driver_missing_desc: Kubudika uku kungachitika para dalaivala ya MediaTek USB yikuŵikika yayi. Dofyani pa Download Drivers kuti muŵikepo dalaivala ya MediaTek USB, yambiskaniso kompyuta yinu, ndipo yezganiso.
err_cache_file_missing_desc: Fayilo ya firmware yakusungika yikusoŵa. Sankhani Sankhani Software kuti muzengeso mafayilo agho mwafumiska panji kukoperaso firmware archive. Iyi ni suzgo la mafayilo gha mu chigaŵa, suzgo la kulumikizgana kwa USB yayi.
sel_cache_retry_tooltip: Bwelerani ku Sankhani Sofutiweya kuti muzengeso panji kukopera phukusi la firmware.
sel_cache_retry_select_release: Sankhani firmware iyo mungasanga kuti muyitoreso.
err_generic_flash_failed_desc: Kubudika kwambura kulindilirika kukachitika apo ŵakaŵikanga ({detail}). Zimani magesi ghose pa player, lumikizaniso para mwaphalirika, ndipo yezganiso.
flash_method_confirm: Nthowa yakuŵikamo yikasintha na kuŵa {method}. Woneseskani kuti player yafumiskikapo na kuzimwa, ndipo dofyani pa Next.
flash_failover_note: {method} wakayamba yayi kuŵika. Pamanyuma pakuti woseŵera wazimika na kuwuskapo magesi, {other} yizamugwiliskirika nchito m’malo mwake.
themepack_card_desc: Kusazgapo mitu yakutowa ya ŵanthu, vithuzithuzi vyakuwoneka makora, na mafonti agho ghapangika mwakupambanapambana kuti ghawoneskeke pa 360p.
themepack_step1_title: Khwerero 1: Lumikizani mu USB Kusungirako Mode
themepack_step1_desc:
1. Yambiskani player yinu mwa kugwira batani la Power.
2. Para Rockbox yayamba, ŵikani khebo ya USB mu kompyuta yinu.
3. Usange mwaphalirika pa skrini ya woseŵera, manyani USB Storage mode mwakuti chipangizo chiwoneke nga ni drive.
themepack_step2_title: Khwerero 2: Sankhani Chikwatu chilichose pa Player .
themepack_step2_desc: Chifukwa chakuti mapulogalamu ghakugwiliskira ntchito (nga ni macOS) ghakubisa ma dotfile (nga ni .rockbox) mwa kuŵikapo mtima, mungasankha chikwatu CHILICHOSE panji mizu ya galimoto pa woseŵera winu. Tizamusanga panji kupanga chilongozgo cha .rockbox kwa imwe.
themepack_complete: Theme pack yaŵikika makora! Sono mungadumura player yinu mwakuvikilirika na kusankha mutu mu Rockbox (Makonzedwe > Makonzedwe gha Mutu).
themepack_err_not_found: Tingasanga yayi panji kuyambiska .rockbox pa diski iyo yasankhika. Chonde wonani kuti mwasankha chikwatu pa player yinu.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_title: Nthowa yakwamba: Yambiskaniso woseŵera na kulumikizgaso
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. Muwuskemo khebo ya USB.
2. Nkhongono woseŵera kubwerera pa ndipo muleke kuti boot mu Rockbox.
3. Para Rockbox yayamba kugwira ntchito, lumikizaniso khebo ya USB, ndipo pamanyuma mudinizge Continue.
rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: App iyi yikuwonelera kulumikizgana kwa ADB (mpaka masekondi 30). Usange chipangizo chasangika, mitu yikusamuskika ndipo woseŵera wakuyambaso mwaŵene. Apo yayi, luta panthazi ku USB Kusungirako Mode.
rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: Palije chipangizo cha ADB icho chikuwoneka mu masekondi 30; kulutilira na USB Kusungirako Mode.
rockbox_wizard_no_adb: Palije ADB binary iyo yikusangika pa pulogiramu iyi; kulutilira na USB Kusungirako Mode.
rockbox_wizard_adb_pushing: Kukankhira mitu na mafonti pa ADB...
rockbox_wizard_adb_push_failed: Kutumizga kwa ADB kwatondeka; Kuwelera ku USB Kusungirako Mode
rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. Lekani USB Storage Mode pa woseŵera mwakuti yiwoneke nga ni galimoto.
2. Sankhani chikwatu CHILICHOSE pa player iyo ili musi umu (.rockbox, Nyimbo, Mitu, panji mizu ya galimoto, chikwatu chakubisika cha .rockbox chikusangika mwachindunji).
3. Pulogalamu iyi yikusazga mitu ya 360p na mafonti mu, kulemba pa mafayilo gha zina limoza.
rockbox_wizard_done_desc: Sono mungadumura player mwakuvikilirika na kusankha mutu mu Rockbox (Makonzedwe > Makonzedwe gha Mutu).
rockbox_stage_installing: Kuŵika mitu ya Rockbox na mafonti...
rockbox_cleanup_deleting: Kufumiska chikwatu cha .rockbox kufuma mu woseŵera...
rockbox_cleanup_failed_note: Sofutiweya yinu yiphya yikaŵikika, kweni chikwatu chakale cha .rockbox chikatondeka kufumiskikapo. Fufutani chikwatu cha .rockbox pa woseŵera na woko usange mukukhumba kwamba kwakutowa.
rockbox_stage_disconnect_extra: Woseŵera wakujumpha yumoza wakukolerana. Muwuskemo vinyake na kuleka waka uyo mukuŵika.
rockbox_stage_pushing: Woseŵera wasangika. Kuŵika mitu ya chikaya na mafonti...
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_y1: Gwirani batani la pakati kuti muŵikepo magesi pa Y1 yinu, lumikizaniso USB, na kusankha USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_power: Gwirani batani la magesi kuti muŵikepo magesi pa player yinu, lumikizaniso USB, na kusankha USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_recover_troubleshoot: Kasi chipangizo chikuyamba yayi? Wezgeranipo pulogiramu yakwamba
rockbox_step1_disconnect_power_on: Chonde fumyanipo na kuŵika magesi pa {model} yinu, ndipo dofyani pa Next .
rockbox_step1_power_on_button: Lekani USB, gwirani {button} kuti muŵe na magesi pa {model} yinu, ndipo pamanyuma mudinizge Next.
rockbox_step_usb_storage_mode: Chonde ŵikanipo USB pa chipangizo chinu na kudinya pa Next .
rockbox_step_usb_storage_folder: Chonde ŵikanipo USB pa {model} yinu, ndipo sankhani dilayivu iyo yikuwoneka .
rockbox_step_select_player_folder: Chonde sankhani seŵero ilo panji limoza mwa mafoda agho ghalipo .
rockbox_power_on_prompt_sp_y1: Lekani USB na magesi pa Y1 yinu, ndipo pamanyuma mudinizge Next.
rockbox_power_on_prompt_sp_other: Lekani USB na kuŵika magesi pa {model} yinu, ndipo pamanyuma mudinizge Next.
rockbox_ask_running_fmt: Kasi Rockbox yikugwira ntchito pa {model} yinu?
rockbox_manual_guide:
1. Sankhani 'USB Kusungirako Mode' pa woseŵera winu.
2. Dofyani pa 'Browse Folder...' kuti musankhe player yinu na kuŵika mitu.
rockbox_site_themes_note: Kuzenga kwa Rockbox uku kukugwiriskira ncito mitu ya 240 × 320, iyo yikuŵikika pamoza yayi. Penjani mitu yaulere ya woseŵera winu kufuma pa webusayiti ya mitu ya Rockbox:
rockbox_site_themes_open: Julani malo gha mutu wa Rockbox .
rockbox_troubleshoot_desc: Usange {model} yinu yikuyamba yayi, fumyanipo USB, gwirani batani la magesi kwa maminiti 10 kuti muŵikeso magesi, ndipo muŵikepo magesi. Panji kuwezgerapo pulogiramu yakwamba.
err_storage_full_desc: Malo ghakusungirako vinthu ghamara pa kompyuta yinu. Chonde fumulani malo pa diski yinu na kuyezgaso.
err_usb_lost_title: Kulumikizana kwa USB kukaŵa kuti kwamara.
legacy_cleanup_desc: Mtundu wakale wa Updater uchili pa kompyuta iyi ndipo ukutora malo pa diski. Kuwuskapo kukufwatura malo agha.
legacy_cleanup_reclaim: Kupokeraso pafupifupi {size} ya malo pa diski
legacy_cleanup_remove_app_cb: Fumiskanipo pulogiramu yakale ya Innioasis Updater na mafoda ghakovwira
legacy_cleanup_keep_platform_tools_cb: Sungani Vipangizo vya Android (ADB / Fastboot) vyaŵikika
legacy_cleanup_platform_tools_hint: Usange mukugwiliskira ntchito yayi ADB panji Fastboot kuwaro kwa Updater CE, fumiskanipo chimanyikwiro kuti muwuskemo na kusangaso malo ghanyake ghakusungirako.
legacy_cleanup_done_msg: Kutozga makora kuŵika kwa chiharo na kusangaso malo gha pa diski.
legacy_cleanup_card_desc: Mtundu wakale wa Updater uchili pa kompyuta iyi. Kuwuskapo kukufwatura malo pa diski.
legacy_cleanup_confirm_body: Ivi vikuwuskapo chomene pulogiramu yakale, firmware iyo mwakopera, na mafayilo ghanyake agho ghakhalako.
legacy_cleanup_tools_body: Kufumiskiramo Vipangizo vya Android (ADB / Fastboot) navyo? Sankhani Sungani usange mukugwiliskira ntchito ADB.
log_btn_goto_file_tip: Vumbulani fayilo ya chikalata mu Finder / Explorer
log_btn_save_file_tip: Tumirani fayilo ya log iyo yalongoreka pa diski
settings_arm64_driver_note: Wovwiri wa ARM64 wa Windows ngwambura kuyezgeka. Pa ma laputopu gha Snapdragon na RTX Spark, Zadig wangagwiliskirika nchito na Kukhozgera Siginecha ya Dalaivala yakulemala kuŵika WinUSB panji libusb ya chipangizo cha MT6227 Preloader mu Manejala wa Chipangizo. Wonani buku la dalaivala la ARM64 kuti mumanye ndondomeko.
keep_data_which_firmware_fmt: Kasi ni pulogiramu wuli iyo yikugwira ntchito pa {model} yinu sono?
